subject.title: feat: per-model code-mode capability flags with an "auto" master-switch tier

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the proposed provider-owned `compat.codeMode: "preferred"` model list as supported policy for the new opt-in `tools.codeMode: "auto"` setting?
rationale: The patch is mechanically additive, but choosing which provider models receive a different model-facing tool surface is ongoing product and provider-policy ownership rather than a purely technical correction.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped auto tier
options.body: Approve the opt-in tier with the proposed catalog-owned preferred list, retaining `false` as the default and requiring runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the initial catalog list
options.body: Land the generic tier only after reducing the preferred annotations to a maintainer-approved conservative subset.

options.title: Defer the policy surface
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers define a durable owner and update policy for preferred-model annotations.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped auto tier
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in tier with the proposed catalog-owned preferred list, retaining `false` as the default and requiring runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied branch history and PR rationale place steipete closest to the proposed Code Mode and provider-catalog policy.
